people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Now therefore put away the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart to Yahweh, the God of Israel.”
translations.bsb: “Now, therefore,” he said, “get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the LORD, the God of Israel.”
translations.kjv: Now therefore put away, said he, the strange gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto the LORD God of Israel.
translations.asv: Now therefore put away, said he, the foreign gods which are among you, and incline your heart unto Jehovah, the God of Israel.
